results_that_do_not_follow.reason: 'done' is concluded with every check 'met' although P2 was never observed as a catcher of M5b/M13 (line 102) and the registered M5b+M14 pair run (lines 55, 59) has no recorded result.

Roadmap text says the guard-related mutants are caught, but M5b/M13 were caught by P1/Q1 through the guard's error, and the recorded results never show what the guard fixed (M5b with guard removed was not run), so 'what the guard fixed' is unsupported.
Mutations were run in the worktree and restored by git checkout, not on the registered scratch copy; the 'done' rule is applied without noting this departure from the registered set-up.

checks_that_cannot_fail.reason: assert_eq!(h.len()/2, n) only checks the input vector's length, which is true by construction, and never the number of cycles returned, though the ADR claims 'n cycles'.
all() over r.cycles passes vacuously if the result has no cycles, and the cycle count is never asserted.
G2 uses msg.contains(&want) where the registration says exact '=='; any longer message containing the text also passes.
The sine case asserts only an empty residue, not cycle count or ranges, so a wrong cycle set with an empty residue passes.

limits_that_test_nothing.reason: G3 checks only is_ok() for the accepted cases, with no check on the returned equivalent amplitude, so any finite or wrong value passes.
